articles.title: Korea issues cybersecurity advisory after flaws discovered in Java platform
articles.description: Korea's science ministry advised companies Wednesday to carry out emergency security checks and update their systems after vulnerabilities were discovered in the widely used Java programming language. The vulnerabilities found in OpenJDK, an open-source implementation of the Java Platform, could allow malicious actors to execute malware on affected systems, the Ministry of Science and ICT said. articles.title: 3.6 magnitude earthquake hits city in southeastern S. Korea: weather agency
articles.description: A 3.6 magnitude earthquake struck a city in the southeastern province of North Gyeongsang on Tuesday, the weather agency said. The quake hit an area about 22 kilometers northwest of Sangju's city center around 11:10 p.m. with the epicenter located at a depth of 20 km, according to the Korea Meteorological Administration (KMA). articles.title: Fishing boat carrying 7 goes missing off west coast
articles.description: A fishing boat carrying seven people went missing off the west coast Wednesday, with search efforts under way, the Coast Guard said. The 7.93-ton vessel was reported out of reach shortly after 1 a.m., two days after it left a port in Taean, about 110 kilometers southwest of Seoul. The Coast Guard said it has activated a rescue headquarters and sent nine patrol boats and two aircraft to the scene while requesting help from nearby civilian vessels and the Navy.
